description: Train the pinned one-hidden-layer Python MLP on its fixed three-row split and return the test metric history.

input.encoding: [epoch_count, learning_rate, gamma, four row-major 2D feature rows, four labels]

contract.initialization: Start each request at the first model initialization after a fresh import, using the pinned default_rng(42) sequence and fixed source He scales for input width two and hidden width two.
contract.dataloader: Use feature rows 0,1,2 for training and row 3 for testing. The source's shuffle_data is a no-op. Output width is len(train_labels)=3, even if one or more class IDs are absent.
contract.targets: Encode each class label as a length-three vector with 0.99 at the label index and zeros elsewhere.
contract.forward: Append a bias feature of one; compute input-to-hidden affine transform, ReLU, then hidden-to-output affine transform with no output activation.
contract.updates: For each epoch, visit the three training rows in order and apply one sample gradient step. delta_out=output-target; delta_hidden=(delta_out*w2^T)*(z1>0); subtract learning_rate times the input/hidden and hidden/output gradients.
contract.metrics: After all three row updates in an epoch, score the single test row. Accuracy uses first-index argmax tie behavior. Loss is sum((output-target)^2)/2. Multiply learning_rate by gamma after recording the epoch metrics; do not stop early.
contract.output_values: Return epoch_count, all test-accuracy values, all test-loss values, and the mean test accuracy printed by train().
contract.errors: Reject malformed length, nonfinite values, unsupported hyperparameters, feature values outside the finite quarter-step grid in [-2,2], and labels outside {0,1,2} with -1. Null output or insufficient capacity returns -2 without writes.

pinned_source.symbol: Dataloader.get_train_test_data / Dataloader.get_inout_dim / MLP.initialize / MLP.forward / MLP.back_prop / MLP.train / MLP.get_acc_loss
dependencies: NumPy default_rng(42) initialization sequence, fixed to its first model draw
